**Business Domain:**
Public Transportation Monitoring and Analysis

**Business Scenario:**
A metropolitan city is implementing an advanced Public Transportation Monitoring and Analysis System to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of its public transit services. The system is designed to track and analyze passenger traffic across various transit lines and stations, providing detailed insights into passenger flow patterns at different times of the day. The system will collect data on passenger volume categorized by ticket type (high, medium, low) and scheduled service levels across all transit lines and stations.

The goal is to optimize transit operations by adjusting service levels according to real-time passenger demand data, improving passenger satisfaction, and reducing operational costs. The system will support detailed reporting and predictive analytics to assist transit authorities in decision-making processes, such as planning new routes, adjusting existing schedules, and managing peak-time traffic.

The system will include a comprehensive database to store and manage data related to transit lines, stations, passenger counts, and service schedules. It will also feature advanced data visualization tools for real-time monitoring and analysis, enabling the city to enhance its public transportation services and provide a seamless travel experience for commuters.
